note: Written before any cycle-13 report is opened, as the brief requires. The scores and the reasons below are filled in from the capture's own artifacts once the run completes; what is here now is the part that does not depend on it — what I accept from the last cycle without argument, and what I changed and why.
what_i_will_not_argue_with: The twelfth cycle's completeness pass corrected four of its own reports and I accept all four. The standing line's ink on wood is 34.4 per cent per-pixel, not 90.4, and one frame of seventy was above 60 per cent rather than sixty-seven. The fault was real and I fixed it; the number that made it blocking was about two and a half times too large.

Three of the four 'dead straight' edges in the material row's blocking finding are the scroll container clipping its last sheet, not flat tear masks. The row-level claim survives on an independent survey — 38 per cent of 181 edges under a pixel — so the library still needed the work, but the prescription pointed at the wrong edges and I have not touched those.

The three blank sheets at the end of 08 are folded, unopened letters with the reader's name on the outside. 'The thread commits a row's paper before its ink' is not what is wrong there and I have changed nothing on account of it.

09_two_devices.png and 16_setup_android.png are missing and stay missing: there is no /dev/kvm on this machine and docs/PHONES.md carries the measurement. Nothing in the set shows a motor being driven, so the clause about the PWA substitute reading as equally physical has nothing to be equal to. That should be said rather than assumed.

what_i_changed.the_tear_library: The material row's blocking finding was half a check and half a fracture. tools/check/torn.py measured the quieter of each mask's top and bottom edge, and most piece kinds guillotine one of those two — on every one of them it reported the straightness of an edge meant to be straight and called it the library's roughness. Measuring only the edges the generator says it tore, the library the finding was made on reads 2.81 median and twelve of fifty-six under 2, not 2.00 and twenty-eight. The fracture was the other half: the amplitude floor let a sheet be drawn nearly smooth however it was torn, and the Hurst exponent ran to 1.15, which is a clean pull. Regenerated at a raised floor and a lowered exponent, with the slow drift cut to pay for the depth, it reads 4.50 median, six under 2, thirty inside the 2.88-5.14 a critic was content with. All 56 edge-light renders were re-rendered against the new silhouettes and checked against them.
what_i_changed.the_tear_that_ate_the_chip: SlicedMasks.fitFor let a tear's borders take four fifths of a piece. On a chip 86 by 34 points that is the whole of it: no row at all of its 102 is nine tenths solid paper, and the tear takes 6.5 per cent of the word written on it. At a half, forty-eight rows are paper and the tear takes 3.4 per cent. A third is further than this goes — there the shrunk render packs the contact shadow into a line beside the paper measuring 28.3 grey levels against ink at 30.
what_i_changed.the_standing_line: A mask is rendered about 578 pixels tall and drawn as a nine-patch, which keeps its border cells at their rendered size however short the piece is: on the partner's strip, 86 points tall, the median writable mask eats 60 of them and the deepest eats 157 — and the strip picked one by the hash of their mood. The library says how far a tear eats in the unit a piece is laid out in now, offers the masks a piece of a given height can still be written on, and the strip asks for those. Six words 28 points inside the tear before, none after, read off the widgets rather than off a photograph.
what_i_changed.a_state_change_takes_time: The surface that carries one person's state to the other changed between two frames: the cross-dissolve lasted two of a sixteen-frame take and the board did not move for the remaining fourteen. Nothing was animating it. The new sheet is laid over the old one over Motion.land, through the same widget the shell uses to change region, and the take is twenty-five frames of a 420 ms landing.
what_i_changed.the_two_phones_agree_about_the_time: The far phone's clock was the frozen now plus however long the capture had been running; the near phone's moves only when the harness steps the driven clock. 08 takes an hour and a quarter to shoot, and the two were eighteen minutes apart about what time it was. The far phone's clock is the frozen now and only that.
what_i_changed.the_desk_adds_up: shareOfTheDesk charged chrome per module and returned the minima unclamped: at the 780-point slot Us is photographed in it handed five modules 466 points of a desk with 358 left on it. It shares in proportion when the room will not stretch, and takes the module list as a parameter so the sixth module three files promise is built and measured rather than asserted.
what_i_changed.the_hold_stops_being_a_race: a_hold_is_a_thing_happening went red on one suite run in three, and a red suite is a capture that photographs nothing. The charge was written against DateTime.now() and reaches full at two seconds. It is the charging ticker's own elapsed now — the same wall clock to the frame on a phone, and under a test it advances by exactly what the test pumps. The case named for the clock the harness drives was answered by the wall clock too: DrivenClock.enabled read the build flag where every other handle reads the flag or the bus.
smaller: 07_feeling_landing is seven takes rather than six: 6.272 s against its own 6 s minimum, and the seventh is Static, the one family of six that six landings never showed.
The persistence guard the brief says must fail the build can see the JavaScript that ships with the app; app/web/push/sw.js is named with what it may write and how much of it.
The rituals card stops keeping a score: '3 kept · 53 times' was every keeping of every ritual added together. Checked on the glances against the whole seeded year.
The partner's status line scales down rather than truncating: at 360 points, the width the clips are shot at, it was losing nine of its forty characters.
The briefing told the critics the stills were 360 by 780 at four times scale. No scene file agreed. It now says what is true and why the set is shot at two widths.
The year's import stops awaiting every put: 14,061 events were 14,061 round trips through the microtask queue, 6,726 ms of an 8,551 ms first frame.
The report says how many sheets are drawing the flat colour rather than paper, not only which stock was late.

Two more checks were measuring the wrong thing and are fixed: the Dart copy of holes.py's walk never got its fringe fix, and the seam gate was the old library's roughness rather than a fact about seams.

measured_and_not_fixed.the_writing_does_not_sit_on_the_ruled_li: The pitch already agrees — the lined stocks carry a clean 81 px rule grid and a piece takes a window of its stock at one image pixel per device pixel, so the hero's rules and its ink baselines are both 81 px apart. Only the phase is wrong, by a constant 0.20 to 0.22 of a pitch. The phase is the seeded patch offset, which is arbitrary, so snapping it to the multiple of the pitch that puts a rule under the first baseline changes no layout at all. It needs the rule phase and pitch per stock in the index and the piece's first baseline from getDistanceToBaseline. Written into evidence/logs/lines.json.
measured_and_not_fixed.a_piece_is_not_grown_to_clear_its_own_ba: Making every piece clear its tear's band by arithmetic grows a 38-point scrap to 194 for the word '41s', which is a shadow the size of its cell. The general answer is for the render to shrink with the piece, which is fitFor's room, and half is as far as that goes before the contact shadow beside the paper is darker than ink. Where a piece is held larger than its writing — the partner's strip — the slack goes into clearing the band, and that is all that is claimed.
